steps.content:
July 18, N.F. 115
The Day After Returning to DisCity from the Black Tide at WhiteSands Border

steps.speaker: Wynn
steps.content: Chief, I thought you finished all the work that piled up while you were out! Why are you still getting this many messages? Did... something happen outside?

Wynn's gaze is fixed on your terminal, her worry etched in the furrow of her brow. The entire MBCC has been tiptoeing around you for days, speaking in hushed tones. That Wynn has broken that silent accord speaks volumes. You are a ghost of your former self—all sharp edges and shadowed eyes. With a heavy hand, you reach out and mute the terminal, finally silencing its relentless, pulsing stream of alerts.
These are external materials I requested. I asked the Intelligence Department to organize them before sending, but apparently, I underestimated how much there would be.

steps.speaker: Wynn
steps.content: It's all about that border outpost program, right? The... "Lighthouse keepers"? And there's the research on the Rancors. Some of these files are super old, and others have really high clearance. They've been working on this for ages! But with this much to read, are you sure you don't need a hand? I can help!

No, I need to review this myself... I have to prove that Rancors can be controlled, even without restrictions, and justify my collaboration with them. This power will be essential for the conflicts to come. My experience with the lighthouse keeper is the best evidence I have.

But no matter what proof I give them, the higher-ups refuse to approve my collaboration with the Rancor units... They just see this power as a bunch of rabid dogs. I need more documentation. More evidence... more...
A sudden, violent shudder from your terminal cuts your rambling short.
Wait... A highest-priority emergency dispatch?

steps.speaker: Nightingale
steps.content: Chief, we've received an urgent distress call from the FAC border defense forces. They report an unidentified Sinner, disguised as a refugee, attempting to breach the city! A young girl is with them, displaying DisCity traits, suspected to be a hostage!

steps.speaker: Nightingale
steps.content: The target passed all initial screenings and registration. However, they failed the test from our newly implemented Rancor detection device. The FAC immediately raised the alert level and attempted an intercept, but the target erupted with Mania and forced their way into the city! This is a confirmed S-Class Sinner.
An S-Class Rancor? Are we in direct conflict already?

steps.speaker: Nightingale
steps.content: Affirmative. The special Rancor containment protocol was activated, but suppression failed. The target has already breached the West District. This is now a top-level emergency situation. The MBCC must respond immediately to apprehend the target and secure the city's defenses.

The emergency is a slap to your senses, shocking your weary mind back into sharp, painful clarity. Coat slung over an arm, you grab the terminal and stalk toward the elevator, your focus locked on Nightingale's report.
Understood. I'm heading to the on-site command post immediately.
In DisCity, "Rancor" is a word steeped in the briny stench of blood and metal. You force your exhausted body into combat readiness, hoping this attack won't disrupt the report you've been preparing.

steps.speaker: FAC Captain
steps.content: Chief, over here! We've been laying down suppressive fire as per the new anti-Rancor tactical manual, but with limited effect. We've had to extend our defensive line to keep the target contained.

steps.speaker: FAC Captain
steps.content: The support teams have completed the evacuation, and the combat zone is clear. We are ready to hand over command of the operation to you!
According to the data and their behavior, the target's speed and strength are significantly enhanced, but there are still signs of rationality... Your tactical decisions were sound.

You burst onto the scene and, within moments, are directed into the heart of the operational grid. The heat hits you first, then the choking scent of scorched metal and ash. Your eyes slit against the haze, every nerve ending tightening with the old, cold familiarity of a live battlefield.

steps.speaker: FAC Soldier
steps.content: Release the hostage and surrender! I repeat, you cannot overcome DisCity's defenses! Let the hostage go and stand down immediately!

Your assessment concludes the FAC's response was tactically sound. While they failed to capture the target, they successfully evacuated all civilians and contained their movement. The situation is more stable than you anticipated. Now the problem is...
Where's the hostage? Is that the girl on the target's back?

steps.speaker: FAC Captain
steps.content: Yes. According to the follow-up briefing, the target initially attempted to enter posing as a refugee. She claimed to have found the hostage in WhiteSands, kidnapped from DisCity by another group, and said she was taking her home. However, this story has little credibility.

steps.speaker: FAC Captain
steps.content: We assess that the target took the hostage from the start, planning to use her as a means of infiltration. Even after her cover was blown, she has maintained tight control over the girl. We must consider the possibility that she will use the hostage as a shield or a weapon against our forces.

Your eyes track the distant Sinner, a lone figure holding her own against a storm of gunfire. Even from here, you can see the distinct bulge beneath her WhiteSands cloak. It's the hostage, shielded and secure.
You may not be a combat expert, but you recognize mastery when you see it.
She flows through the chaos with a decisive grace, rising, falling, and evading without a single misstep, all while maintaining perfect stability for the person in her grasp.
For confronting a Rancor, the suppressive fire is being held back... they're prioritizing the hostage's safety. A confirmed DisCity resident... so that's why she's acting so recklessly?
Her movements are calculated. She seems skilled at attrition and crowd control. Is this formal training, or just Rancor instinct? But holding a Rancor alone shouldn't...

Shouldn't make it feel so familiar. The style is agile, precise, and utterly fierce. A dance that never yields, evading every bullet while cutting through the suppressive fire. A ghost of a memory tugs at you; you've seen this style before. In the curtain of gunfire, she moves like a...
...Storm petrel.
You wrench your gaze away. This isn't the time for unexplained intuition. You need to end this, now, before the situation spirals beyond control.

The hostage seems safe, for the moment. But I can't rely on the suspect's conscience. I need to create an opening to bind her movements with my shackles... Maybe if I reveal my command position, I can draw her in...

steps.speaker: FAC Captain
steps.content: Chief! Watch out!!
Thud! Thud, thud!

The dull thud of bodies hitting the ground snaps you from your thoughts. Your head jerks up just in time to see the Rancor wielder shatter the defensive line, charging directly at you. She's spotted you, and she may know exactly what you're worth!

steps.speaker: FAC Captain
steps.content: Hold the line! Maintain formation! Rear ranks, advance and fill the gaps! Do not let up the suppressive fire!
Amidst the chaos, the Rancor wielder abandons all defense. With sudden, terrifying purpose, she charges, cutting a direct path toward you as if the intervening soldiers were mere ghosts.

The FAC troops react, surging forward to form a barricade of flesh and steel. It's futile. The S-Class Sinner doesn't break stride, effortlessly kicking them aside like scattered stones. In a heartbeat, the path between you is clear.

There is no time to think, only to act. You stand your ground, refusing to dodge, your gaze locked on the approaching figure. Every ounce of your will is focused on finding the perfect moment to unleash your shackles.
Clank!

steps.speaker: FAC Captain
steps.content: Chief!!!
Under your intense focus, the world distorts. Time stretches and sound warps; the clash of metal and the FAC captain's warning cry reach your ears a critical second too late.
A dagger—drawn from beneath the Sinner's cloak—scrapes against a soldier's armor. The shower of sparks still dances in your vision, yet you remain rooted, paralyzed by instinct or inevitability.
Ceto...?!

steps.speaker: Ceto
steps.content: It's you...?!

Then, a gust of wind. It tears back the assailant's hood and sweeps the dust from the air. The cheap fabric flies away, revealing the face hidden in shadow—and a pair of slightly widened, hauntingly familiar eyes.
The Rancor wielder who kidnapped a girl, forced her way through the city gates, infiltrated Syndicate, and violently resisted arrest... turns out to be Ceto.

steps.speaker: FAC Captain
steps.content: That's an opening! Now!

Your hand acts on instinct, your fragile shackles reaching Ceto a heartbeat before the FAC's strike. A dozen questions flash through your mind, but one truth eclipses them all: a confrontation between her and the FAC must be prevented at all costs. It could only end in ruin.
You have to move first to seize control, but there's no time to explain—

steps.speaker: Ceto
steps.content: You're... controlling me?

A crimson light bleeds through her sand-colored cloak as the mental channel between you slams open once again. Her emotions hit you not as a wave, but a raw, violent storm. This connection is agonizingly familiar, the very bond that once made you comrades in the churning tides.
I don't mean to harm you. I know you must have your reasons for all this...

steps.speaker: Ceto
steps.content: You're on their side? You think I'm here to threaten this place too?
Her gaze locks with yours, a maelstrom of incomprehension, anger, and a coldness that chills you to the bone. You try to form words, but help arrives with its predictably catastrophic timing.

steps.speaker: FAC Captain
steps.content: Chief, excellent work! Fall back, watch for a counterattack! Over here! Chief has contained the target with the shackles! Disarm her, now!

steps.speaker: Ceto
steps.content: So... you're here to capture me too.
No, that's not it—

The FAC soldiers, your dutiful protectors, shove you into their designated safety zone without a chance to object. Your shouts are swallowed by the chaos. Helpless, you watch as Ceto—her movements still hampered by your shackles—loses her balance and falls hard to the ground.

Soldiers swarm over her, pinning her limbs while shouting the mantra of the moment: "Dangerous Rancor!" Again and again, she struggles to lift her head, her eyes desperately searching the crowd for you. Each time she finds your gaze, a soldier forces her face back into the dirt.
Don't hurt her! I know her! Let her go. I'll take responsibility!
Let her go!
But the FAC is lost in the euphoria of subduing an S-Class threat. Only Ceto hears your voice. She manages to lift her head, sees your anxiety, and answers you with a cold, bitter snort.

steps.speaker: Ceto
steps.content: ...Stop making such a damn fuss. This isn't your problem, so back off... Just stay out of it!
She's deliberately cutting ties with you.
You're hiding something, aren't you? What are you really trying to do? If someone is threatening you, you could just tell me. I can help!

Ceto ignores you, then suddenly freezes, her struggles ceasing as she stares at something behind you. The tension drains from her body all at once. Defeated, she allows the soldiers to lead her away without another ounce of resistance.

You turn to follow her gaze. There, standing with a female sheriff, is the young hostage girl—rescued immediately after Ceto's arrest. Wrapped in a warm blanket and clutching a steaming drink, she is safe.

steps.speaker: Nightingale
steps.content: Chief! Reports confirm the Sinner has been detained. Are you alright? Are you injured?!

Your adjutant vaults from the transport and closes the distance between you in hurried strides, concern written on her face. You wrench your gaze from the little girl and meet her with a shake of your head.
I'm fine. I know that Rancor wielder, and I've used my shackles on her before. Thanks to that, we managed to keep the situation from spiraling completely out of control.

But the woman I know holds no ill will toward DisCity. She isn't the type to orchestrate a kidnapping or an attack for personal gain. There must be another reason... Now that the FAC has captured her, can we still get access to her for interrogation?

Your mind replays that final image of Jasmine, etched in memory. The uncertainty of how other departments will handle Ceto fades next to one clear truth: an interrogation is the greatest opportunity you will get—for the case, and for her.
Yet Nightingale hesitates, words caught in her throat, as she hands you the terminal.

steps.speaker: Nightingale
steps.content: I understand your concern, Chief. But before we proceed with the interrogation... you need to see this first.

The cold screen light stutters, then stabilizes as the connection seals. The face that appears is unfamiliar: an official whose smile is a perfunctory gesture, starkly at odds with the cold, assessing hardness in his eyes. His identity tag marks him as part of the newly formed City-State Security Bureau.

steps.speaker: Official
steps.content: Chief, impressive work containing the situation. Your reputation is well-earned. However... the reality of this incident may be more complex. This Rancor wielder has a suspicious background and exhibited dangerous behavior. We suspect an external actor is involved.

steps.speaker: Official
steps.content: An organization, most likely. As you know, the Rancors have a history of orchestrating conspiracies against DisCity. We need you to initiate special interrogation protocols immediately. Extract all viable intelligence.

options: It's too early to draw conclusions.

choices.text: It's too early to draw conclusions.

steps.content: The details don't add up. She took a hostage, but her primary action was protecting that girl. She engaged only combatants and had no backup.
She also never once weaponized her Rancor against anyone. That's not the pattern of a calculated attack. I don't see the hand of an organization here. Not yet.
Despite his mild tone, the official's attitude is impervious to challenge, his every word meticulously engineered to serve his agenda.

steps.speaker: Official
steps.content: There it is. I've heard much about your... principled stance, Chief. But you must see that Rancors and DisCorps are, by their very nature, a threat to DisCity's stability.

steps.speaker: Official
steps.content: They are unstable, uncontrollable humanoid weapons. Paired with an exiled warlord who feeds on chaos... do you truly believe they have the city's best interests at heart? Some patriotic defense? Let's be realistic.

steps.speaker: Official
steps.content: Chief, Rancors operate outside the bounds of reason. We cannot afford to apply normal logic. We need to know who planted this bomb. This is for the safety of every citizen in DisCity.

My thoughts exactly. For the safety of the city, I will be conducting the interrogation and leading the investigation. I brought her in. If I hand her over prematurely and your people miss a crucial detail due to... procedural haste, that negligence would be on me.
You refuse to back down. The official, recognizing a futile debate, chooses to disengage—or perhaps he simply disdains to entertain what he sees as your sophistry.

steps.speaker: Official
steps.content: Very well. We can discuss the interrogation plan. You may conduct the first round, but please understand that, given the severity, we will dictate the procedure and provide the questions with full oversight. If any security risks emerge, we will assume control immediately.

steps.speaker: Official
steps.content: I trust in your professionalism. We share the same goal, after all: to neutralize all threats to our stability. All of them.
A perfunctory goodbye, and the line goes dead. You stand rigid, staring at the screen, watching the pulse of the indicator light slow... and then blink out completely.

steps.speaker: Nightingale
steps.content: Chief, the preliminary interrogation protocol for Ceto has been filed. I've been notified that a specific list of questions will be sent to your terminal shortly. Regarding this matter... what do you plan to do?
...First, have Wynn pull all external files on the border outposts from my terminal.
As long as the interrogation happens at MBCC, in our facility, we still control the room.
I know that Rancor wielder, the lighthouse keeper <color=#fb9259>Ceto</color>... I trust my judgment of her.
